verdict.rationale: Working Copy's docs describe a 'Repository Agent' AI assistant that lets users browse, search, read/modify files, commit, pull and push via conversation, directly enabling natural-language command operation, plus AI-generated commit messages. However, this is a single vendor-claimed feature with no independent community validation of its reliability or scope, and it doesn't cover all app functions (e.g., merge conflict resolution, tagging) via NL.
